summary: Phase roles-2026-10 — Frontend fully validated on public URL (desktop 1440x900 + mobile 375x800). All 13 requested flows pass. Admin (admin@casa-academy.com) login → /admin; header shows Administration + Se déconnecter only on desktop AND mobile (no 'Mon espace', no 'Évaluation' in the Header menu — the string 'Évaluation M16' only appears inside the back-office tab list which is correct). Direct admin navigation to /espace and /modules/M01/learn redirects to /admin; /evaluation redirects to /admin?onglet=evaluation. Learner (apprenant@casa-academy.ci) /admin and /evaluation are refused (stay on /connexion or /espace). All 8 admin tabs load via data-testid admin-tab-*: Tableau de bord shows real counters incl. 'QUESTIONS PUBLIÉES 144' with 'Notées 85 · formatives 51 · positionnement 8', 'CERTIFICATIONS AU CATALOGUE 4 · Modèles de certificat publiés', 'CERTIFICATS DÉLIVRÉS 6 · 0 valides · 6 révoqués' (text-transform uppercase in CSS, raw text matches spec). Journal shows no raw 'pedagogical_lead' or 'published' tokens. Apprenants tab: Créer un compte apprenant form has only PRÉNOM, NOM, E-MAIL, MOT DE PASSE INITIAL (0 checkboxes, no role selector); 4 retired staff rows (lead/author/reviewer/evaluator@casa-academy.ci) show 'rôles hérités' label and 'Réactiver' button (confirming active=false); admin row (admin@casa-academy.com) has NO user-deactivate-* and NO user-temp-password-* buttons. Learner creation + 'Définir un mot de passe provisoire' inline form (user-temp-password-input-<email> + user-temp-password-save-<email>) works end-to-end: created QA-ROLE-* learner, set new temp password, logged in as that learner with new password (lands /espace), and old initial password now returns 'Adresse e-mail ou mot de passe incorrect' confirming session_version bump. Retired lead@ / author@casa-academy.ci login refused (2 attempts each, screen stays on /connexion). Public /inscription creates a learner and lands on /espace. Admin read-only public pages: /modules/M16 hides module-start-button and shows 'Mode administrateur : consultation en lecture seule'; /parcours/P01 hides enroll button. /parcours shows computed title '4 entrées, 4 parcours, un même socle.' and '4 parcours structurés', with 'Parcours du socle' (P01, P02) and 'Parcours du catalogue documentaire' (P-001, P-002) families both present. /modules/M16 summary shows 'DURÉE PÉDAGOGIQUE ESTIMÉE 10 h' and separately 'TEMPS DE LECTURE DES RESSOURCES ~ 1 min'. Learner /espace shows 'Mes parcours', 'MES FORMATIONS > Cours commencés' and 'CATALOGUE > Cours disponibles' (no 'Vos cours'), no raw status codes. Forgot password page shows mailto:contact@relaisit.com link. Footer 'by Relais IT' link intact. Mobile 375x800: /admin, /espace, /modules/M16 — no horizontal scroll (scrollWidth=375); mobile menu toggle opens correct admin menu (no Mon espace / Évaluation).
action_items: Cleanup QA-created learners (prefix qa-role-): qa-role-ui-90167@example.com, qa-role-reg-90167@example.com, qa-role-ui-17133@example.com, qa-role-reg-83460@example.com, qa-role-ui-83460@example.com (names start with 'QA-ROLE-').
critical_code_review_comments: TempPassword control is an inline form (not a window.prompt) with its own data-testid=user-temp-password-input-<email> and user-temp-password-save-<email> — correctly keeps the password out of browser native dialog and audit logs; verified sessions-closed notice shown.

Admin row in Users.js correctly omits deactivate and TempPassword controls (checked via absence of user-deactivate-admin@casa-academy.com and user-temp-password-admin@casa-academy.com testids) — matches spec 'Admin cannot be deactivated/reset from UI'.

Retired accounts (lead/author/reviewer/evaluator@casa-academy.ci) render 'rôles hérités' badge (4 occurrences in Apprenants panel) and expose a 'Réactiver' button (user-activate-*) — consistent with role=learner + active=false model.

/parcours title text appears twice in body ('4 entrées, 4 parcours, un même socle.' + '4 parcours structurés') — spec-aligned. Families 'Parcours du socle' and 'Parcours du catalogue documentaire' render with Public: labels.

Dashboard uppercase labels come from CSS text-transform; underlying text matches spec exactly ('Questions publiées', 'Certifications au catalogue', 'Certificats délivrés') so screen reader text is intact.

/espace layout uses three distinct sections ('PARCOURS > Mes parcours', 'MES FORMATIONS > Cours commencés', 'CATALOGUE > Cours disponibles') — the string 'Vos cours' no longer appears anywhere on /espace.
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md as-is (admin@casa-academy.com / Admin2026!, apprenant@casa-academy.ci / Apprenant2026!). Retired accounts attempted with throwaway password (2 attempts each).
seed_data_creation: Created 3 learners via public /inscription and admin /admin > Apprenants with the prefix qa-role-: qa-role-ui-90167@example.com, qa-role-reg-90167@example.com, qa-role-ui-17133@example.com, qa-role-ui-83460@example.com, qa-role-reg-83460@example.com. All role=learner. One of them had a temp password set to QaRoleNew2026!. No admin was modified, no legacy test_*@example.com account was deactivated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Key testids verified: logout-button, mobile-menu-toggle, admin-tab-tableau-de-bord/contenus/relecture/journal/evaluation/import-export/utilisateurs/certificats, new-user-first_name/last_name/email/password/submit, users-search, users-role-filter, user-deactivate-<email>, user-activate-<email>, user-temp-password-<email>, user-temp-password-input-<email>, user-temp-password-save-<email>, register-first-name-input/last-name-input/email-input/password-input/submit-button, module-start-button. TempPassword is an INLINE form not a window.prompt — tests must open the button then fill the dedicated input then click save. Admin login lands on /admin directly (homeFor() in auth.js). Admin can read /modules/* and /parcours/* in read-only mode: the CTA 'Commencer le module' is replaced by a notice and /pathways enroll is hidden.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bug found. Three initial failures in the first exploratory run were test-script issues (not product bugs): (1) counters test checked case-sensitive strings but CSS text-transform uppercases them, (2) Apprenants form inputs were missed because the first script ran against the default dashboard panel instead of clicking the admin-tab-utilisateurs tab, (3) TempPassword was mis-handled as a native dialog instead of an inline form. All three were fixed in follow-up targeted runs and now PASS.
